description: Describe a chart semantically (bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, radar, scatter, qr, graph, gauge, …) and get back a permanent, hosted Image-Charts image URL that renders server-side and embeds anywhere. No client-side chart library required.

colors.description: Hex colors WITHOUT a leading #, one per series (or per slice for pie/doughnut).

format.description: url (default) returns only the hosted URL; png also fetches the rendered PNG; both returns the URL and the image.

icac.description: Image-Charts Enterprise account id. When the IMAGE_CHARTS_SECRET env var is also set, the URL is HMAC-SHA256 signed (&ichm=…). Ignored on Dedicated Cloud (IMAGE_CHARTS_HOST).

labels.description: Category / slice labels: x-axis ticks for bar & line, slice labels for pie & doughnut, axis labels for radar. An empty string skips one label.

legend.description: Show a legend built from series names. true = right side; or pick a side explicitly.

series.description: One or more data series. Required for every type except qr and graph. Use `data` for numeric series, `points` for scatter.

data.description: Numeric values for this series (bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, radar, gauge). Auto-scaled by Image-Charts. Use this for every type except scatter.

size.description: Pixel size. Each side <= 999 and width*height <= 998001. Sensible per-type defaults are used when omitted (e.g. 700x400 for bar/line, 300x300 for qr).

type.description: Semantic chart type. Call list_chart_types for the full catalog and the Image-Charts `cht` each maps to.

name: create_chart
title: Create a hosted chart
